root_causes: Strict 8-second observation hold cap plus frequent 9-second raw intervals creates genuine unsupported seconds under the frozen conservative contract.
Occasional longer raw gaps further fragment context; a 31-bin window requires all 248 seconds, so small scattered holes remove many windows.
Issues=1 invalidates labels only; additional label loss is reproducible, and does not gate aggregate validity.
No import, timestamp, label alignment or window implementation defect was found in the audited source chain.
contract_verdict: No correctness repair justified. Allowing a nine-second hold would be a new observational assumption, not recovered measurements; not applied.
unrecoverable_limits: Original pre-cleaning missingness and upstream zero/forward-filled values are unavailable.
Upstream IAM >4000W clipping cannot be reversed.
Physical cycles cannot be identified independently from threshold segments.
Real inter-record gaps remain unsupported; strict8 audit does not recover early House19 positive windows.

downstream_checklist: Explicitly select input paths and freeze their SHA256 before training.
Treat audit inputs as byte-identical strict8 data, not a repaired dataset or extra evidence.
Choose date blocks by support only and freeze before fitting; never tune with historical outer scores.
Apply all 31 samples inside block, 1800-second half-gaps, and whole threshold-event boundary exclusion.
Report complete observed segments as well as windows; do not treat threshold segments as independent physical cycles.
Keep missing labels unknown; do not fill aggregate gaps, change the 200W definition, or use labels to gate aggregate validity.
Fit normalization only on training data; report exposure and tiny complete-event support.
Describe any evaluation on these dates as reused source development evidence, not fresh final testing.
